T: One present left. No child forgotten.
D: Santa's clumsy younger son sets out with Grandsanta and an old sleigh to deliver the one gift that got missed.
P: Serve the mains when the old sleigh finally lands in Cornwall.
S: the elves running the huge Christmas Eve operation
Popcorn tossed with melted white chocolate, red and green sprinkles and a pinch of salt, spread out to set then broken into clusters.
Grandsanta and his beloved old sleigh
Shortcrust pastry cut into rounds, filled with fruit mince and orange zest, topped with pastry stars, baked at 190C for 18 minutes, dusted with icing sugar.
Bryony's spinach and feta filo parcels
Bryony the wrapping elf who can wrap anything

Buttered filo wrapped around spinach, feta, ricotta and dill, tied with a blanched chive ribbon like a present and baked golden and flaky. Wilt 250g baby spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 150g crumbled feta, 100g ricotta, chopped dill, an egg and pepper. Brush a sheet of filo with melted butter, top with another, cut into 4 squares and repeat to make 12. Spoon filling in the middle, gather the corners into a bundle and tie with a chive dipped in hot water. Brush with butter and bake at 190C for 20 minutes.
M: the house in Cornwall where Gwen waits for her bike

Short pastry filled with diced beef skirt, potato, swede and onion with plenty of pepper, crimped along the side, baked golden with tomato relish. Rub 150g cold butter into 400g plain flour with a pinch of salt and bind with about 120ml cold water, then chill 30 minutes. Dice 400g beef skirt, 1 potato, a quarter swede and an onion small and toss with salt and lots of pepper. Roll the pastry into 4 rounds, pile the filling on one half, fold and crimp. Brush with egg and bake at 180C for 50 minutes.
Christmas dinner with the whole Claus family
Turkey breast rolled with sage, onion and bacon stuffing, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, with roast potatoes, sprouts and cranberry sauce.
W: A rich fruit Christmas pudding steamed until hot, served in thick slices with warm orange and vanilla custard and a spoon of whipped cream. Heat the Christmas pudding following the packet directions until hot right through. Warm 500ml custard gently with the finely grated zest of an orange and half a tsp vanilla extract, stirring, without boiling. Whip 300ml cream to soft peaks. Cut the pudding into thick slices, pour over the orange custard and top each with a spoon of cream and a little more zest.
K: the reindeer pulling the old sleigh

Milk, cream, eggs and brown sugar cooked gently with ginger, cinnamon and nutmeg until thick, chilled and topped with whipped cream and crumbled gingernut. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 80g brown sugar in a pot. Stir in 600ml milk, 200ml cream, 1 tsp ground ginger, half a tsp cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg. Heat gently, stirring all the time, until it coats the back of a spoon, about 8 minutes, without boiling. Strain and chill for 2 hours. Pour into glasses, top with whipped cream and crumble a gingernut biscuit over each.

s.note: the elves running the huge Christmas Eve operation
s.how: Pop 100g popping corn and spread on a lined tray. Melt 200g white chocolate and drizzle all over, then scatter with red and green sprinkles and a pinch of sea salt. Leave to set for 30 minutes, then break into clusters for the mission team.

s.note: Grandsanta and his beloved old sleigh
s.how: Cut 3 sheets of shortcrust into rounds and press into a patty tin. Fill with fruit mince mixed with orange zest. Top each with a small pastry star, brush with beaten egg and bake at 190C for 18 minutes. Cool a little and dust with icing sugar.

m.note: Christmas dinner with the whole Claus family
m.how: Fry chopped bacon and onion with sage and breadcrumbs for a stuffing. Butterfly a 1.5kg turkey breast, spread with stuffing, roll and tie. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes with 1kg potatoes alongside. Serve sliced with roasted brussels sprouts and cranberry sauce.
